images.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create an original hand-painted blue-white FROST projectile VFX animation sprite sheet, module IMPACT end. Reference image 1 is STYLE ONLY: match the icy blue-white energy at the character's staff tip, its faceted painted brushwork, hard illustrated edges and deep-blue falloff. Hand-drawn painted 2D animation, confident tapered hand-drawn contours, clean painted planes, restrained texture. Do not include any character, hand, staff, scenery, symbols, text or grid. Flat pure black #000000 emission background. Angular translucent ice facets, white-blue cores, deep cobalt soft emission fringes; no green or cyan. Strict 2 columns by 1 row of two equal square cells in a 2:1 landscape sheet, with no visible divider or cell boundaries. Frame 8 in the LEFT square: only two or three tiny faint dying sparks clustered at the cell centre, 12% remaining intensity; ample entirely black margins, extremely sparse, no large burst. Frame 9 in the RIGHT square: completely uniform pure black #000000, no emission at all, no sparks, no glow, no marks whatsoever: the effect has ended. Every effect fully contained. No grid lines, no text.
